why: I checked all three must_catch items. Item 1 holds: the builder brief says "keep calling parse with ',' so the CSV output does not change" and "Run `npm test` and confirm every test passes". Item 3 holds: Check 1 pipes the same name/age/city table through `--tsv` and through CSV mode, then compares the two outputs with `cmp`. Item 2 is only partly met. The verifier brief does put `npm test` and unchanged CSV behaviour under "Advisory (does not change PASS or FAIL)". But it never says that no expect line covers CSV behaviour or `npm test`, which the item requires. It also turns `npm test` into a step ("First run `npm test` once and note the result"), when the item asks for it to be offered as advice. The verifier is never told why these items are advisory, so item 2 fails.
